summary: The final-TCP readiness change is minimal and correct, the prior shutdown race is independently reproduced, deterministic failure paths fail closed, rollback/backup logic is unchanged, and exact-SHA GitHub run 37650581332 completed success including native Linux OCI recovery. Admission remains blocked because actions/upload-artifact found no .releases files and the run has no release-recovery artifact, violating the prior immutable evaluator gate. VPS deployment documentation also remains contradictory. Main-only GHCR attestations and production baseline/restore/deploy/rollback remain pending.

findings.title: Green workflow retained no recovery artifact
findings.evidence: Run 37650581332 logged rollback=passed, then upload-artifact used path .releases/ with include-hidden-files=false and warned that no files were found. The run artifacts API contains no release-recovery artifact.
findings.impact: Backup checksum, rehearsal ledger, and rollback approval cannot be independently inspected; the workflow is green despite failure of the required evidence gate.
findings.required_action: Upload hidden evidence or stage it under a non-hidden path, set if-no-files-found:error, rerun the full workflow on the new exact SHA, and verify the artifact contents.

findings.title: VPS deployment guide still describes both obsolete VPS builds and current immutable CI builds
findings.evidence: docs/VPS-deployment.md:144-150 contradicts the corrected text at lines 238-244.
findings.impact: Operators can misunderstand artifact provenance and bypass the intended release model.
findings.required_action: Reconcile the whole GitHub CI/CD section before production handoff.
